summary: Corrected the mechanism of last turn's lead after tracing how a failed append actually reaches the leader: appendEntries answers a store failure with Success false, a nil rpc error and LastLog taken from the stale in-memory last index, so the leader takes its rejection branch, lowers nextIndex to min(nextIndex-1, resp.LastLog+1), and the follower re-rejects every retry because its stale last index makes the conflict loop treat the vanished entry as present and then miss it in the store - the stair settles at nextIndex one and the success tail that refreshes last contact is skipped. Added four source anchors (raft.go 1461-1470, 1525-1542, 1600-1602, log_cache.go 66-95), ruled out LogCache retention as the explanation for the failed read, rewrote the interpretation with conclusion conditional and defect_claim unresolved, re-pointed the question's hypothesis and discriminator, and revised the knowledge entry whose leader-side sentence was wrong under a changed_premise. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested; incomplete work is the measurement itself, which nothing has yet failed a store inside, plus the untraced effect of the stale index on the follower's own vote responses.
